description: Site: lib.rs:708-777. The trait carries four methods where two would suffice: spec_section_id (the new name), rfc_section_id (deprecated alias), spec_url (new name), rfc_url (deprecated alias). The deprecated aliases are independent default impls returning None, NOT shims that forward to the new methods. Doc explicitly warns 'calling the deprecated alias on a lint that overrides only spec_section_id returns None.' This means callers who do lint.rfc_section_id() on a forward-ported Lint impl get None even when the lint has a section id. The 'deprecated alias' is not an alias; it's a different method that happens to share documentation. Cleaner: either (a) implement rfc_section_id as a forwarding default (fn rfc_section_id() -> Option<&str> { self.spec_section_id() }), so old callers transparently get the new value; (b) remove the deprecated alias entirely now (we're pre-1.0 — semver permits it). Option (a) makes the deprecation actually useful as a migration mechanism. Option (b) lets us strip the dead surface. The current shape is worse than either.
title: spec_section_id / rfc_section_id deprecated-alias pattern doubles the API surface for a soft rename
